Title: Azure Stream Analytics on IoT Edge is now available

Body.Content:
Azure Stream Analytics on IoT Edge is now available

Azure Stream Analytics on IoT Edge is now generally available. This new feature extends the benefits of Microsoft’s unique streaming technology from the cloud to the device level. Azure Stream Analytics on IoT Edge provides a simple way to analyze data in real-time, while using the same familiar programming languages and unified cloud management portal. Azure Stream Analytics on IoT Edge can be used for free until February 1, 2019. The new pricing model will be applicable after February 1, 2019. Custom pricing is available for large scale deployments (more than 5,000 devices).

For more information on pricing, please visit the Azure Stream Analytics Pricing page.

To learn more about this service, please visit the Azure Stream Analytics webpage and check out our announcement blog.
